messages.content:
Write a tech news digest of about 100 words based on these headlines.
Output the digest text only.

Headlines:
- Open-source agent frameworks hit production milestone as adoption triples
- Model-driven agents quietly replace hand-coded orchestration in startups
- Tool-calling reliability becomes the new benchmark for frontier models
- Multi-agent swarms move from demos to regulated enterprise workflows
- Observability standards emerge for tracing agent decisions end to end

message.content: The AI agent landscape is rapidly maturing as open-source frameworks hit a major production milestone, with adoption tripling across the broader tech industry. Startups are quietly replacing hand-coded orchestration with model-driven agents, fundamentally shifting the traditional development paradigm. Meanwhile, tool-calling reliability has emerged as the critical new benchmark for evaluating frontier models. On the enterprise front, multi-agent swarms are moving from early-stage demos into strictly regulated workflows. To manage this growing complexity, new observability standards are emerging to trace agent decisions end to end, ensuring vital transparency and accountability throughout the ecosystem.
